item.title: Recurring Payments: How to Stop Silent Leaks in Your Household Budget
item.description: Subscriptions and regular bills can quietly drain a household budget. Learn how Spendist helps you track recurring payments and expenses.

item.title: What Is Spendist? Meet the Open-Source App for Managing Your Household Budget
item.description: Spendist is an open-source app for managing a household budget, expenses, income, recurring payments, wallets and portable financial data.

item.title: Why Was Spendist Created?
item.description: Spendist grew from more than a decade of expense tracking and over 40,000 recorded transactions. Discover the story behind the project.
